segs.text: The box was sealed. The wallet was new. And someone already had the keys.
parts: The box was sealed. The wallet was new.
And someone already had the keys.

segs.text: Last week, Ledger confirmed it found an unauthorised hardware implant inside a wallet sold through one of its authorised resellers in Southeast Asia.
parts: Last week, Ledger confirmed it found an unauthorised hardware implant
inside a wallet sold through one of its authorised resellers in Southeast Asia.

segs.text: On-chain researchers estimate up to ninety-three million dollars was drained, from more than three hundred wallets.
parts: On-chain researchers estimate up to ninety-three million dollars was drained,
from more than three hundred wallets.

segs.text: Ledger hasn't confirmed that number. It says its own systems and direct sales were not affected, and every confirmed case traces back to that one seller.
parts: It says its own systems and direct sales were not affected,
and every confirmed case traces back to that one seller.

segs.text: If you bought from that reseller recently, don't set the device up. If you already did, move to a fresh recovery phrase, on a device straight from the maker.

If you already did, move to a fresh recovery phrase, on a device straight from the maker.

segs.text: And no real company will ever ask for your twenty-four words.
